visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera establishes a medium shot of a white wooden desk against a plain white wall. The desk is cluttered with books, a desk lamp, and small figurines on the top shelf. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a person's hands holding a clear plastic bottle of nail polish remover and pouring it onto a white wipe. The person's nails are neatly manicured. (3) The camera moves to a close-up of the whiteboard panel. Hands wearing a yellow glove vigorously wipe at permanent marker doodles. The black ink dissolves and is wiped away, leaving the surface pristine. (4) The camera pans out to show the full desk structure. A digital overlay shows an IKEA product listing for the 'MICKE' desk including a price and dimensions. (5) A series of quick cuts shows various parts of the desk: the stationery shelf, the lamp being turned on, the drawer contents, and finally a wide shot of the room featuring the matching IKEA ergonomic chair.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a practical home maintenance guide combined with a product review. It demonstrates an effective way to remove permanent marker stains from a whiteboard using nail polish remover and then provides a detailed tour of an IKEA desk setup, emphasizing its organizational features for students.
